params.description: Mean sea level pressure commonly used for weather analysis and forecasting.
params.notes: Typically ranges from ~800 hPa to ~1100 hPa.

params.description: Mass of cloud water per unit mass of air.
params.notes: Ranges typically from 0 to ~0.02 in standard atmospheric conditions.

params.description: Mass of ice water per unit mass of air.
params.notes: Ranges typically from 0 to ~0.02 in cold cloud regions.

params.description: Mass of rain water per unit mass of air.
params.notes: Ranges up to ~0.03 in heavy precipitation conditions.

params.description: Mass of snow crystals per unit mass of air.
params.notes: Ranges typically up to ~0.02 in strong winter storms.

params.description: Mass of graupel (snow pellets) per unit mass of air.
params.notes: Typically near 0 unless convective storms produce graupel.

params.description: Reflectivity factor derived from microphysical states.
params.notes: Ranges from negative values in clear air to 75+ dBZ in extreme storms.

params.description: Horizontal visibility at the surface in meters.
params.notes: Typically up to 10–20 km in clear air; 100000 m ~ 100 km in some models.

params.description: Zonal (east-west) wind component in m/s.
params.notes: Negative = westward, positive = eastward.

params.description: Meridional (north-south) wind component in m/s.
params.notes: Negative = southward, positive = northward.

params.description: Measurement of atmospheric ventilation (wind speed × mixing height).
params.notes: Units in m**2 s**-1; ranges vary widely.

params.description: Surface gust wind speed in m/s.
params.notes: Can exceed 100 m/s in extreme storms (rare).

params.description: Height of a given pressure level in geopotential meters (≈ actual meters).
params.notes: Values can approach 30,000 gpm at very high altitudes.

params.description: Atmospheric temperature in Kelvin at isobaric levels.
params.notes: Ranges from very cold (~150K) to very hot (~350K).

params.description: Ratio of water vapor partial pressure to saturation vapor pressure, in percent.
params.notes: 0% = fully dry, 100% = fully saturated.

params.description: Mass of water vapor per total mass of air at isobaric levels.
params.notes: Ranges typically up to ~0.04 in tropical climates.

params.description: Rate of pressure change with time, indicative of updrafts/downdrafts (Pa/s).
params.notes: Negative = rising air, positive = sinking air.

params.description: Vertical velocity in geometric height coordinates (m/s).
params.notes: Negative = upward motion, positive = downward motion.

params.description: Sum of Earth's and relative vorticity at isobaric levels.
params.notes: Positive = cyclonic (NH), negative = anticyclonic.

params.description: Mass ratio of ozone to air at a given pressure level.
params.notes: Typically small, especially in troposphere; larger in stratosphere.

params.description: Fraction of sky covered by cloud (0%–100%).
params.notes: 0% = clear, 100% = fully overcast.

params.description: Index indicating potential for wildfire growth. Higher = more unstable/dry.
params.notes: Ranges 2–6, with 6 indicating highest risk.

params.description: Mean sea level pressure computed via Eta model reduction method.
params.notes: Similar to standard MSLP (about 800–1100 hPa).

params.description: Atmospheric pressure at the surface.
params.notes: Lower near high elevations, higher at sea level.

params.description: Elevation of Earth’s surface in meters.
params.notes: Negative below sea level; highest peaks > 8000 m.

params.description: Soil temperature at a specific depth below ground (K).
params.notes: Varies with soil type, moisture, and climate.

params.description: Fraction of soil volume occupied by water.
params.notes: 0 = completely dry, 1 = fully saturated.

params.description: Fraction of soil water that is liquid (unfrozen).
params.notes: Excludes frozen water in the soil.

params.description: Water stored on vegetation surfaces per unit area (kg/m^2).
params.notes: Ranges from 0 to a few kg/m^2 on wet canopies.

params.parameter_name: Water equivalent of accumulated snow depth (deprecated)
params.description: Snow water equivalent if melted. (deprecated).
params.notes: Can reach up to 1000 kg/m^2 in extreme snowpacks.

params.description: Depth of snow on the ground in meters.
params.notes: Can exceed 10 m in heavy snowfall regions.

params.description: unknown
params.notes: unknown

params.description: Thickness of sea ice on ocean surfaces in meters.
params.notes: Ranges up to several meters in polar regions.

params.description: Air temperature at 2m above ground in Kelvin.
params.notes: Ranges from ~180K to ~330K.

params.description: Mass of water vapor per unit mass of air at 2m height.
params.notes: Ranges up to ~0.04 in warm/humid conditions.

params.description: Dewpoint temperature at 2m above ground (K).
params.notes: Cannot exceed actual temperature; ~330K is extremely high dewpoint.

params.description: Relative humidity at 2m above ground, in percent.
params.notes: 0% = fully dry, 100% = saturated near surface.

params.description: Temperature as perceived factoring humidity/wind (feels-like).
params.notes: Sometimes called heat index or wind chill combined.

params.description: East-west wind at 10m above ground (m/s).
params.notes: Negative = westward, positive = eastward.

params.description: North-south wind at 10m above ground (m/s).
params.notes: Negative = southward, positive = northward.

params.description: Percentage of precipitation that is frozen (snow/sleet).
params.notes: Ranges from 0% (all liquid) to 100% (all frozen).

params.description: Rate of precipitation at the surface (kg m^-2 s^-1).
params.notes: 0.1 is extremely heavy precipitation.

params.description: Indicates presence (1) or absence (0) of snow (code table 4.222).
params.notes: Categorical parameter for snow.

params.description: Indicates presence (1) or absence (0) of ice pellets.
params.notes: Code table 4.222.

params.description: Indicates presence (1) or absence (0) of freezing rain.
params.notes: Code table 4.222 for supercooled liquid precipitation.

params.description: Indicates presence (1) or absence (0) of rain (liquid).
params.notes: Code table 4.222.

params.parameter_name: U-component of atmospheric surface momentum flux
V-component of atmospheric surface momentum flux

params.description: Surface roughness length used in flux calculations, in meters.
params.notes: Up to several meters in forests or urban areas.

params.description: Scaling velocity representing turbulent shear near the surface.
params.notes: Higher friction velocity = stronger turbulence.

params.parameter_name: Zonal flux of gravity wave stress
Meridional flux of gravity wave stress

params.description: Fraction of surface covered by vegetation, in percent.
params.notes: 0% = bare ground, 100% = fully vegetated.

params.description: Categorical index representing soil texture (code table 4.213).
params.notes: Values correspond to sand, clay, silt, etc.

params.description: Soil moisture fraction below which plants cannot extract water.
params.notes: Typically 0.1–0.3 for many soil types.

params.description: Soil moisture fraction at which drainage stops (not saturated).
params.notes: Often 0.2–0.4 for many soils.

params.description: Number of seconds of bright sunshine at the surface.
params.notes: 0 = no sun, 86400 = continuous 24h sunlight.

params.description: Stability index comparing a surface parcel to 500 hPa environment.
params.notes: Negative = unstable, positive = stable.

params.description: Energy available for convection, indicating thunderstorm potential.
params.notes: Values over 4000 J/kg can be extreme.

params.description: Energy preventing convection (negative buoyancy).
params.notes: Values >200–300 J/kg often inhibit storms.

params.description: Total column water vapor if all condensed (kg/m^2).
params.notes: 5–60 typical; can exceed 70 in tropics.

params.description: Integrated column of cloud liquid water (kg/m^2).
params.notes: Often <3; can be higher in strong convection.

params.description: Total column ozone in Dobson Units (DU).
params.notes: Typical range ~200–500 DU, <200 = ozone hole conditions.

params.description: Percentage of sky covered by low-level clouds.
params.notes: 0% = none, 100% = fully covered by low clouds.

params.description: Percentage of sky covered by mid-level clouds.
params.notes: 0% = none, 100% = fully covered by mid-level clouds.

params.description: Percentage of sky covered by high-level clouds (e.g., cirrus).
params.notes: 0% = none, 100% = fully covered by high clouds.

params.description: Atmospheric pressure at the level of maximum wind.
params.notes: Jet streams often ~200–300 hPa, can vary widely.

params.description: Measure of horizontal vorticity a storm ingests, linked to rotating storms.
params.notes: Values >300–400 can signal supercell potential.

params.description: East-west component of storm motion (m/s).
params.notes: Negative = westward, positive = eastward.

params.description: North-south component of storm motion (m/s).
params.notes: Negative = southward, positive = northward.

params.description: Pressure at the tropopause (Pa).
Height in the standard atmosphere for the tropopause or reference altitude.
params.notes: Often ~11000 m in mid-latitudes.

params.description: Shear in vertical wind speed near the tropopause (s^-1).
params.notes: Higher shear may indicate strong jet streams.

params.description: East-west wind at 100m above ground in m/s.
params.notes: Negative = westward, positive = eastward.

params.description: North-south wind at 100m above ground in m/s.
params.notes: Negative = southward, positive = northward.

params.description: Lifted index using the best 4 layers near surface, indicating stability.
params.notes: Negative = unstable, positive = stable.

params.description: Temperature an air parcel would have if brought adiabatically to 1000 hPa.
params.notes: Widely used to identify air mass properties.

params.parameter_name: Pressure of level from which parcel was lifted
params.description: Pressure of the originating level from which a parcel is lifted.
params.notes: Near surface ~100000 Pa; can be lower in upper levels.

params.description: Mask indicating land (1) vs. sea (0).
params.notes: Coastal cells may have fractional values.

params.description: Fraction of sea surface covered by ice (0=none, 1=fully covered).
params.notes: Intermediate values near the ice edge.

params.description: Surface temperature of sea ice in Kelvin.
params.notes: Below freezing up to near 273K, can approach 300K if melting.

params.description: Wind speed at the surface.
params.notes: Measured in meters per second (m/s). Values can range from calm conditions (~0 m/s) to hurricane-force winds (>30 m/s).

params.description: Wind direction at the surface, indicating the direction from which the wind is blowing.
params.notes: Measured in degrees true. 0° indicates wind coming from the north, 90° from the east, 180° from the south, and 270° from the west.

params.description: Zonal (east-west) component of the wind at the surface.
params.notes: Negative values indicate westward winds, while positive values indicate eastward winds. Measured in meters per second (m/s).

params.description: Meridional (north-south) component of the wind at the surface.
params.notes: Negative values indicate southward winds, while positive values indicate northward winds. Measured in meters per second (m/s).

params.parameter_name: Significant height of combined wind waves and swell
params.description: Significant height of the combined wind waves and swell.
params.notes: Represents the average height of the highest one-third of waves. Measured in meters (m).

params.description: Mean period of the primary wave.
params.notes: Indicates the average time interval between consecutive wave crests. Measured in seconds (s).

params.description: Direction from which the primary wave is coming.
params.notes: Measured in degrees true. 0° indicates waves coming from the north, 90° from the east, etc.

params.description: Significant height of wind-generated waves.
params.notes: Represents the average height of the highest one-third of wind-driven waves. Measured in meters (m).

params.description: Significant height of the total swell.
params.notes: Represents the average height of the highest one-third of swell waves. Measured in meters (m).

params.description: Mean period of wind-generated waves.
params.notes: Indicates the average time interval between consecutive wind wave crests. Measured in seconds (s).

params.description: Mean period of the total swell.
params.notes: Indicates the average time interval between consecutive swell wave crests. Measured in seconds (s).

params.description: Direction from which the wind-generated waves are coming.
params.notes: Measured in degrees true. 0° indicates waves coming from the north, 90° from the east, etc.

params.description: Direction from which the swell waves are coming.
params.notes: Measured in degrees true. 0° indicates waves coming from the north, 90° from the east, etc.
